scope: Source-bound correspondence between captured directory index names and target FILE_NAME instances; collation/tree/content remain separate required work.

primary_sources.supports: The version3.0/3.1 filename structure binds a counted original name to a parent FILE reference; its reserved bytes are not documented authority for exact membership comparison.
FILE_NAME uses attribute type0x30; the instance is local to its FILE record. Attribute lists identify the records carrying a file's attributes.

local_findings: The current directory path finishes a complete index graph before the existing global final reread phase. A new supplied-reader membership mode can share that one source/capture epoch instead of starting a second opener.

Observer::read retains every exact span and compares overlaps for byte agreement. It permits identical overlap; it is not a blanket prohibition on repeated logical records. Every added read still consumes global read/byte/retention quotas and the final reread stream.

The completed MFT map and initialized/data bounds already address arbitrary full record ordinals with checked multiply/add. New targets must be validated as base FILEs with exact nonzero reference sequences and supported in-use flags; an ordinal alone cannot identify one.

acquire_list currently has explicit MFT/Volume/directory alias checks. Adding target closures needs a precise shared set of already acquired metadata-list and directory-stream mappings; the present directory-only pointer comparison is not a general target-list ownership proof.

The new filename collector preserves separate parent/name/namespace/record-instance values and can expose validated missing record dependencies. It has no source access. Reuse it after real source acquisition rather than copying its record/list parser.
contract_questions: Use a separate private request/observation for membership so existing bootstrap/directory contracts, output and read order remain compatible. Define controls, exact target/edge ordering, distinct-target quota and global-budget interaction before code.

Bind target/extension/list bytes to the same source/window/profile/epoch and exact initialized MFT map, then the existing ordered final reread. Define source failure and partial-prefix behavior without producing native source authority from supplied assertions.

Preserve every directory edge and every filename instance. Exact original parent/name/namespace correspondence can be reported separately from duplicate multiplicity, opaque information bytes, collation, lookup and complete namespace health.

Specify cache identity and behavior for repeated full references, conflicting sequences for one ordinal, existing bootstrap/directory records, a target that was already seen as an extension, and physical aliases among new nonresident lists.

Keep missing/stale/unsupported/changed/budget-limited states distinct. A known valid edge prefix cannot qualify unobserved edges, a target-record inventory cannot establish complete directory/tree membership, and a source reread is not an atomic snapshot.
Native worker framing/replay, held-file integration and eventual public command admission require their own source-bound contracts/tests before the new private observation is exposed.
